title: MATLAB code for Bayesian model selection and parameter estimation of the transverse elastic modulus of a composite ply
description:
MATLAB implementation of the Bayesian analysis used in the accompanying manuscript on micromechanical model selection and parameter estimation of the transverse elastic modulus E2 of a unidirectional composite ply.

Contents: Metropolis-Hastings MCMC and a model-switching (equal-dimension RJMCMC) chain; three micromechanical models (Halpin-Tsai with xi = 2, Halpin-Tsai with the Hewitt-de Malherbe reinforcement factor, and Puck); the digitised 15-point glass-epoxy data set; and run_all.m, which reproduces Table 6 and Supplementary Tables S1-S4 of the paper. Requires MATLAB R2026b and the Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox.
